preferred_b2_stack.name: Taiwan domain text plus official events plus historical media metadata
preferred_b2_stack.rationale: FSC supplies clean unlabeled Taiwan financial language; TWSE/TPEx preserve official event text, ticker and official publication semantics; GDELT supplies historical media metadata and a strictly limited media-tone proxy without mirroring publisher bodies.

fallback_b2_stack.name: Official-and-domain-text minimum stack
fallback_b2_stack.rationale: If a bounded GDELT B2 coverage probe fails, B2 can still be completed reproducibly with the audited FSC corpus and forward official TWSE/TPEx announcements; media history is then a documented coverage limitation, not replaced by fragile scraping.

global_rules: Official announcements and media news remain separate source_type values and timestamp semantics.
GDELT Tone is MEDIA_TONE_PROXY, never VALIDATED_FINANCIAL_SENTIMENT or ground truth.
Only b2_whitelist sources may enter B2; conditional sources require a new passing gate and manifest revision.
Publisher article bodies are not fetched, cached, trained on or redistributed without source-specific rights approval.
eLAND remains permanently excluded from active work.
B1 authorizes no model training, pseudo-label generation, manual labeling or bulk corpus download.
